a: Which doeth great things and unsearchable
s: ; marvellous things without number:
d: Whose kingdom is from everlasting to everlasting
Who healeth the broken in heart with mercy
Who judgeth the righteous with true equity

a: With him is wisdom and strength
s: , he hath counsel and understanding.
d: In his hand are the depths of the earth
Before his throne is light unapproachable
Unto his name belongeth all thanksgiving

a: Acquaint now thyself with him
s: , and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.
d: Walk uprightly before the LORD
Offer sacrifices of righteousness
Keep the holy commandments

p: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips;
a: I have esteemed the words of his mouth
s: more than my necessary food.
d: my soul hath longed for his salvation
I have remembered his holy covenant
my heart hath trusted in his mercy

a: The Spirit of God hath made me
s: , and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
d: The word of the Lord created the heavens
His tender mercies are over all his works
The hand of the Almighty formed the earth

p: For
a: his eyes are upon the ways of man
s: , and he seeth all his goings.
d: his righteous throne is established on high
his holy counsel shall stand for ever
his mercy endureth unto all generations

a: God thundereth marvellously with his voice
s: ; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.
d: The LORD reigneth in beauty and great power
His holy light shineth over all the earth
He maketh the clouds his chariot in heaven

a: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning
s: , O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
d: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD
I will sing praises unto the God of Jacob
My mouth shall speak of thy lovingkindness

a: I have set the LORD always before me
s: : because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
d: My soul doth wait for the God of my salvation
In his holy word have I placed my confidence
I will sing praises unto the Rock of my refuge

a: The law of the LORD is perfect
s: , converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
d: The word of our God shall stand
The holy covenant is unchangeable
The path of righteousness is peace

p: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but
a: we will remember the name of the LORD
s: our God.
d: our trust shall be in the God of Jacob
his righteous arm shall give the victory
our soul shall rejoice in his holy power

p: LORD, I have loved
a: the habitation of thy house
s: , and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
d: the beauty of thy temple
the courts of thy praise
the secret of thy presence

a: The LORD is my strength and my shield
s: ; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
d: The God of Jacob is our high refuge
The Lord of hosts is with his people
His holy arm hath wrought our salvation

a: Be of good courage
s: , and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
d: Stand fast in faith
Fear not the enemy
Trust in his mercy

a: Thou art my hiding place
s: ; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
d: The LORD is my fortress
God is our rock of hope
He is my strong salvation

p: For
a: the word of the LORD is right
s: ; and all his works are done in truth.
d: the judgments of God are true
his holy throne is exalted
his counsel shall endure

p: Blessed is the nation
a: whose God is the LORD
s: ; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
d: that feareth his name
that keepeth his law
that walketh in truth

a: O magnify the LORD with me
s: , and let us exalt his name together.
d: Give thanks unto the holy King
Sing praises to the living God
Rejoice in the Lord of hosts

a: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens
s: ; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
d: Thy righteousness shineth as the morning
Thy holy throne is established forever
Thy truth is declared among the nations

p: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for
a: my expectation is from him
d: his mercy shall preserve me
my soul shall not be moved
in his word do I hope

p: O God, thou art my God;
a: early will I seek thee
s: : my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
d: my tongue shall praise thee
my soul shall bless thee
in faith will I call

a: How amiable are thy tabernacles
s: , O LORD of hosts!
d: How glorious is thy sanctuary
Blessed is the place of prayer
Great is the house of praise

p: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and
a: to sing praises unto thy name
s: , O most High:
d: to declare thy lovingkindness in truth
to worship before thy glorious throne
to rejoice in the house of our God

p: O come,
a: let us worship and bow down
s: : let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
d: let us praise his holy name
let us enter his sanctuary
let us rejoice before him

p: O worship the LORD
a: in the beauty of holiness
s: : fear before him, all the earth.
d: with songs of thanksgiving
before his glorious throne
in his sacred dwelling

a: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD
s: , all ye lands.
d: Praise ye the name of the Almighty
Sing praises to the King of heaven
Give thanks unto the God of Jacob

p: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and
a: forget not all his benefits
d: rejoice in his holy salvation
trust in his tender compassions
proclaim his truth to the people

a: Open thou mine eyes
s: , that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
d: Incline thou my heart
Enlighten thou my soul
Lead me in thy truth

a: My help cometh from the LORD
s: , which made heaven and earth.
d: My hope is in the living God
My soul trusteth in the Almighty
His right hand hath delivered me

a: Great is the LORD
s: , and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
d: Holy is our God
The King of heaven
The Lord of all

p: The LORD is gracious, and
a: full of compassion; slow to anger
s: , and of great mercy.
d: glorious in holiness; fearful in praises
righteous in judgment; holy in truth
our rock of salvation; our strong tower

a: The fear of the LORD
s: is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
d: The wisdom of God
The holy statute
The way of truth

p: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and
a: he shall direct thy paths
d: he shall make thee to prosper
thy soul shall dwell at ease
peace shall be in thy borders

a: Honour the LORD with thy substance
s: , and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
d: Trust in the Almighty with all thy heart
Keep the commandments of life with joy
Offer sacrifices of praise unto the King

a: Wisdom is the principal thing
s: ; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
d: Righteousness exalteth a nation
The fear of God is true life
Understanding is a wellspring

p: But the path of the just is
a: as the shining light
s: , that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
d: as a watered garden
like a fruitful tree
as a crown of glory

p: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but
a: with the lowly is wisdom
d: with the upright is peace
in the righteous is life
before the humble is honor

p: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but
a: a good word maketh it glad
d: a joyful sound bringeth healing
the counsel of peace is sweet
a soft answer turneth wrath

a: Righteousness exalteth a nation
s: : but sin is a reproach to any people.
d: Wisdom establisheth the throne
The fear of God bringeth peace
Mercy and truth preserve kings

a: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance
s: : but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
d: A wise son heareth his father's instruction
The soft tongue breaketh the bone of pride
A faithful witness delivereth humble souls

p: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and
a: a word spoken in due season
s: , how good is it!
d: the prayer of an upright heart
a faithful friend in trouble
the rebuke of a wise man

p: When a man's ways
a: please the LORD
s: , he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
d: keep his covenant
walk in righteousness
fear his judgment

p: How much better is it
a: to get wisdom than gold!
s: and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
d: to choose virtue than pearls!
to love peace than great power!
to seek truth than rubies!

a: A good name
s: is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
d: True wisdom
Holy peace
Pure honor

p: A word fitly spoken is like
a: apples of gold in pictures of silver
d: crowns of glory upon the head of kings
precious jewels in a golden vessel
honeycombs of sweet understanding

p: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but
a: a woman that feareth the LORD
s: , she shall be praised.
d: the righteous that walk in truth
a prudent servant of the house
the humble that keep his word

p: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and
a: there is no new thing under the sun
d: all the days of man are vanity and sorrow
a generation passeth away and another cometh
the eye of man is never satisfied with seeing

p: I know that,
a: whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever
s: : nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him.
d: the counsel of the Almighty shall never fail
his righteous works declare his eternal power
the throne of his majesty endureth for ever

a: Two are better than one
s: ; because they have a good reward for their labour.
d: Wisdom is better than strength
Peace is better than riches
Patience is better than pride

p: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for
a: God is in heaven, and thou upon earth
s: : therefore let thy words be few.
d: The LORD is holy, and his counsel is deep
His eyes behold the children of all men
He searcheth the secret thoughts of hearts

a: A good name is better than precious ointment
s: ; and the day of death than the day of one's birth.
d: A quiet spirit is better than great possessions
Wisdom is more profitable than houses and land
The rebuke of the wise is better than songs

p: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and
a: the patient in spirit
s: is better than the proud in spirit.
d: the humble in heart
the prudent in soul
the upright in way

p: I returned, and saw under the sun, that
a: the race is not to the swift
s: , nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
d: the kingdom is not to the proud
the riches are not to the cruel
the crown is not to the mighty

p: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and
a: the spirit shall return unto God
s: who gave it.
d: the soul shall dwell in peace
the righteous shall see his face
the memory shall never be moved

p: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for
a: thy love is better than wine
d: thy beauty excelleth the roses
thy name is as sweet incense
thy voice bringeth gladness

a: Draw me, we will run after thee
s: : the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.
d: Lead me in the path of righteousness
Show me the glory of thy presence
Teach me the beauty of thy love

p: My beloved spake, and said unto me,
a: Rise up, my love, my fair one
s: , and come away.
d: Awake, O daughter of Zion, and sing
Turn again, my beloved, unto me
Rejoice greatly, O bride of the King

a: The flowers appear on the earth
s: ; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
d: The winter is past and gone
The sweet morning dawneth
The joy of heaven shineth

p: My beloved is mine, and I am his:
a: he feedeth among the lilies
d: his love is sweet wine
his countenance is as Lebanon
his banner over me is love
